SELECT cmu.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, cmu.user_name AS userName, rplu.user_name AS replyUserName,
pc.timestamp AS commentTimestamp, pc.content AS commentContent,
pc.id AS commentId, pc.reply_comment_id AS parentCommentId, pc.post_id AS postId, pc.commenter_id AS commenterId
FROM post_comment AS pc LEFT JOIN login_user AS cmu ON pc.commenter_id = cmu.id LEFT JOIN post_comment AS reply_comment ON pc.reply_comment_id = reply_comment.id -- 避免使用子查询 LEFT JOIN login_user AS rplu ON reply_comment.commenter_id = rplu.id WHERE pc.id = #{commentId}
